The exact bug described (root.receive() returning None at ~1826 for the relay DAO) was fixed by commit e75754a0cf 'test(rpl): three_rpl_stacks reconciled to multicast DIO contract' (Sep 1), which added the DIS/DAO-phase drain the bead asks for: the relay's solicited-DIS multicast DIO echo is now drained at root as RplRejected immediately before relay.send_dao(), so the DAO is the next frame root pops. A later cleanup (5c0ecc11a4) removed a duplicated announce-drain loop.
